- **`scripts/contentful/README.md`** already documents the two tracks as distinct, and states outright: *"A Studio Experiences component (`experiences/*.tsx`) does **not** belong in content-types/ — `sync.js` does not understand it."* The two paths are technically separated at the tooling level.

So the de facto line today: **SFCC owns commerce routes (PLP/PDP/cart/checkout/account) with coded content slots; Contentful Studio owns the leftover `/:slug` space for whole editorial pages.**

It's **Squad-B, Sprint 5**, gated on design.

Everything else in the backlog is a **fixed slot in a commerce template** — SFCC-190/204/253/203 (PLP inserts & bottom zone), SFCC-195/267/266/102 (PDP slide-out tabs), SFCC-90/94/58 (homepage modules), SFCC-55 (footer), SFCC-96 (nav). None references Studio Experiences.

318472193 confirms *"Contentful is the sole CMS… CDA for all customer-facing pages"* (CDA is the delivery path for both tracks), and there's a Contentful Enterprise Onboarding deck — but **no page states the Studio-vs-coded authoring rule.** So it's genuinely undefined in the docs, which is why this decision matters.

content.text:
Read in full — and it's decisive. **The claim is half-true on a technicality but misleading and under-considered as written. Verdict: soften and correct it.**

## What the codebase actually shows

`overrides/app/ssr/connectionPools.ts` is the house pattern for exactly this problem — *"Undici connection pools for SSR upstream origins (TSD §12.1 blast-radius mitigation)… so a slow or flooded integration cannot exhaust connections for unrelated services,"* used via the per-call `dispatcher` option on `fetch()`. It isolates **seven** upstreams: SCAPI/SLAS, SFCC Payments, MuleSoft, Marketing Cloud (auth + REST), Google Places, Booxi.

**Contentful is not one of them.** So connection-pool isolation isn't unavailable — it's the *standard* here; Contentful simply hasn't been added to it.

## Why the claim is misleading

1. **The narrow bit is true:** the `contentful` SDK v11 client is axios-based, so it won't accept an undici `dispatcher` — you can't drop the SDK client straight into `connectionPools.ts`. That much holds.
2. **But "no isolation hook" is too absolute.** Two isolation routes exist: (a) the repo's own pattern — **bypass the SDK and fetch CDA via raw `undici` with a dedicated `contentfulPool`**, exactly like the other seven upstreams (and note `useContentful.ts` *already* uses raw `fetch`, not the SDK, so this is the natural path); (b) if the SDK must be used server-side, pass a custom `httpsAgent` (maxSockets) — axios accepts it.
3. **It conflates two different concerns.** Pool isolation prevents a *slow-but-up* Contentful from exhausting shared SSR connections (a blast-radius/resource concern, §12.1). Graceful degradation only handles Contentful being *down*. A slow-but-up CDA wouldn't trigger graceful degradation yet would still hog connections — so "mitigate via graceful degradation" answers the wrong question. They're complementary, not substitutes.
4. **It's moot today anyway.** The CDA fetch is client-side (browser `fetch`), so there's no server-side pool to isolate yet. This only bites once the SSR-first fetch is built.

Confluence/Jira: no page or ticket owns this — the `§12.1`/`§9.3` references point to the PWA architecture TSD (256835585) as the authority for the pool pattern; the Contentful TSD's claim effectively contradicts it.

## Proposed corrected wording (your ratify)

> *"When the SSR-first CDA fetch is built, isolate Contentful's connections like the other SSR upstreams: add a dedicated `contentfulPool` to `ssr/connectionPools.ts` and fetch CDA via raw `undici` with `{dispatcher: contentfulPool}` (§12.1 blast-radius pattern), rather than through the axios-based SDK client (which can't take an undici dispatcher; if the SDK is used server-side, isolate via a custom `httpsAgent`). Graceful degradation is a separate, complementary fallback for CDA unavailability — not a substitute for pool isolation. Not applicable today: the current CDA fetch is client-side."*

That turns a hand-wavy "can't, so degrade" note into an actionable, architecture-consistent plan.

Ratify that wording and I'll log #16 (and it becomes a §5/§7 correction in the reformat)?

{
  "name": "contentful",
  "description": "Client for Contentful's Content Delivery API",
  "version": "11.12.4",
  "homepage": "https://www.contentful.com/developers/documentation/content-delivery-api/",
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/contentful.cjs"
    }
  },
  "main": "./dist/esm/index.js",
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18"
  },
  "browserslist": [
    ">0.3%",
    "Chrome >= 75",
    "Edge >= 74",
    "Firefox >= 73",
    "Safari >= 13"
  ],
  "tsd": {
    "directory": "test/types",
    "compilerOptions": {
      "rootDir": "./lib",
      "typeRoots": [
        "./lib"
      ]
    }
  },
  "files": [
    "dist",
    "images",
    "ADVANCED.md",
    "CONTRIBUTING.md",
    "MIGRATION.md",
    "README.md",
    "TYPESCRIPT.md",
    "LICENSE"
  ],
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/contentful/contentful.js.git"
  },
  "author": "Contentful <opensource@contentful.com>",
  "license": "MIT",
  "scripts": {
    "clean": "rimraf dist",
    "build": "npm run clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:bundles && rm -rf dist/esm-raw",
    "build:esm": "tsc",
    "build:bundles": "NODE_ENV=production rollup -c",
    "check": "npm run check:cjs && npm run check:esm && npm run check:browser && npm run check:browser-min",
    "check:browser": "es-check es2018 ./dist/contentful.browser.js",
    "check:browser-min": "es-check es2018 ./dist/contentful.browser.min.js",
    "check:cjs": "es-check es2017 './dist/contentful.cjs'",
    "check:esm": "es-check es2017 --module './dist/esm/*.js'",
    "docs:build": "typedoc --options typedoc.json",
    "docs:watch": "npm run docs:build -- --watch",
    "docs:publish": "npm run docs:build && ./node_modules/contentful-sdk-jsdoc/bin/publish-docs.sh contentful.js contentful",
    "lint": "eslint lib test",
    "prettier": "prettier --write '**/*.{jsx,js,ts,tsx}'",
    "prettier:check": "prettier --check '**/*.{jsx,js,ts,tsx}'",
    "pretest": "rimraf coverage",
    "test": "npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run lint && npm run test:types",
    "test:unit": "vitest --run ./test/unit",
    "test:unit:watch": "vitest ./test/unit",
    "test:integration": "vitest --run ./test/integration",
    "test:integration:watch": "vitest ./test/integration",
    "test:size": "size-limit",
    "test:demo-projects": "npm run test:demo-node && npm run test:demo-browser",
    "test:demo-node": "rimraf ./test/output-integration/node/node-modules && npm --prefix ./test/output-integration/node ci && npm --prefix ./test/output-integration/node test",
    "test:demo-browser": "rimraf ./test/output-integration/browser/node-modules && npm --prefix ./test/output-integration/browser ci && npm --prefix ./test/output-integration/browser run setup-test-env && npm --prefix ./test/output-integration/browser run test",
    "test:types": "tsd",
    "test:prepush": "npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:types",
    "semantic-release": "semantic-release",
    "prepare": "husky",
    "precommit": "npm run lint && npm run prettier:check",
    "prepush": "npm run test:prepush"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@contentful/content-source-maps": "^0.11.33",
    "@contentful/rich-text-types": "^16.6.1",
    "axios": "^1.15.0",
    "contentful-resolve-response": "^1.9.4",
    "contentful-sdk-core": "^9.4.4",
    "json-stringify-safe": "^5.0.1",
    "tslib": "^2.8.1",
    "type-fest": "^4.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@babel/plugin-transform-runtime": "^7.24.7",
    "@babel/preset-env": "^7.24.3",
    "@eslint/js": "^9.15.0",
    "@optimize-lodash/rollup-plugin": "^6.0.0",
    "@rollup/plugin-alias": "^5.1.0",
    "@rollup/plugin-babel": "^6.1.0",
    "@rollup/plugin-commonjs": "^26.0.1",
    "@rollup/plugin-json": "^6.1.0",
    "@rollup/plugin-node-resolve": "^15.2.3",
    "@rollup/plugin-replace": "^5.0.5",
    "@rollup/plugin-terser": "^0.4.4",
    "@semantic-release/changelog": "^6.0.1",
    "@size-limit/file": "^11.1.6",
    "@types/json-stringify-safe": "^5.0.0",
    "@types/node": "^25.0.10",
    "contentful-sdk-jsdoc": "^3.1.2",
    "cz-conventional-changelog": "^3.3.0",
    "es-check": "^7.0.0",
    "eslint": "^9.15.0",
    "fast-copy": "^3.0.2",
    "husky": "^9.0.11",
    "lint-staged": "^15.2.10",
    "prettier": "^3.8.1",
    "process": "^0.11.10",
    "rimraf": "^5.0.0",
    "rollup": "^4.13.0",
    "rollup-plugin-visualizer": "^5.12.0",
    "semantic-release": "^25.0.3",
    "size-limit": "^11.1.6",
    "tsd": "^0.31.0",
    "typedoc": "^0.26.4",
    "typescript": "^5.6.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.55.0",
    "vitest": "^3.2.4"
  },
  "config": {
    "commitizen": {
      "path": "./node_modules/cz-conventional-changelog"
    }
  },
  "lint-staged": {
    "*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}": [
      "prettier --write",
      "eslint --fix"
    ],
    "*.md": [
      "prettier --write"
    ]
  },
  "size-limit": [
    {
      "path": "./dist/contentful.browser.js",
      "limit": "85 Kb"
    },
    {
      "path": "./dist/contentful.browser.min.js",
      "limit": "45 Kb"
    }
  ],
  "release": {
    "branches": [
      "master",
      {
        "name": "next",
        "channel": "next",
        "prerelease": true
      }
    ],
    "plugins": [
      [
        "@semantic-release/commit-analyzer",
        {
          "releaseRules": [
            {
              "type": "build",
              "scope": "deps",
              "release": "patch"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "@semantic-release/release-notes-generator",
      "@semantic-release/npm",
      "@semantic-release/changelog",
      "@semantic-release/github"
    ]
  }
}
